name: UV Protection Sunglasses
description: Block harmful UV rays in style with these lightweight, polarized sunglasses. Perfect for beach days, road trips, or casual summer outings. Features scratch-resistant lenses and a durable frame.

name: Floral Beach Dress
description: A breezy, lightweight floral dress made from 100% breathable cotton. Ideal for beach walks, pool parties, or summer brunches. Available in vibrant tropical prints.

name: SPF 50 Sunscreen Lotion
description: Broad-spectrum SPF 50 sunscreen that protects against UVA and UVB rays. Water-resistant formula lasts up to 8 hours. Lightweight, non-greasy, and suitable for all skin types.

name: Inflatable Beach Float
description: Giant inflatable flamingo pool float perfect for lounging in the water. Made from heavy-duty PVC, supports up to 200 lbs. Deflates quickly for easy storage and travel.

name: Waterproof Beach Bag
description: Spacious waterproof tote bag with a zippered wet pocket, insulated bottle holder, and inner organizer. Fits a towel, sunscreen, snacks, and more. Sand-resistant lining for easy cleanup.

name: Men's Swim Trunks
description: Quick-dry swim trunks with a mesh lining and adjustable drawstring waist. Features a zippered back pocket for essentials. Available in bold summer patterns and solid colors.

name: Portable Beach Umbrella
description: Heavy-duty 7ft beach umbrella with UPF 50+ canopy and wind-resistant tilt mechanism. Comes with a sand anchor and carrying bag. Keeps you cool and protected all day long.

name: Aloe Vera After-Sun Gel
description: Soothing aloe vera gel that instantly cools and hydrates sun-exposed skin. Formulated with vitamin E and chamomile extract to reduce redness and peeling. Alcohol-free and fragrance-free.

name: Polarized Sport Sunglasses
description: Sporty wraparound sunglasses with polarized lenses that eliminate glare on water and sand. Lightweight TR90 frame with rubber grip nose pads. Perfect for fishing, cycling, and outdoor sports.

name: Women's Straw Sun Hat
description: Wide-brim woven straw hat with a UPF 50+ rating and adjustable inner band. Packable and foldable for travel. Pairs perfectly with any beach or summer festival outfit.
